expected_plan_risk: Potential key lookup if customer/status include columns are incomplete.
evidence: Joins CustomerAccount to Shipment filtered by CustomerCode/status.
recommendation: Use existing IX_Shipment_Customer_Status and validate include columns in Query Store.

expected_plan_risk: Writer/writer contention possible during status updates.
evidence: usp_UpdateShipmentStatus updates Shipment and appends event history.
recommendation: Keep transaction short; monitor locks and deadlocks; do not add broad indexes to write path.

expected_plan_risk: Sort/key lookup risk on event history if sequence index absent.
evidence: Query needs latest ordered event history per shipment.

expected_plan_risk: Original reporting query scans recent shipments and groups by depot/route/status.
recommendation: Use IX_Shipment_Route_Status_CreatedAt for migration readiness and offload repeated analytics to Databricks later.

expected_plan_risk: Large aggregation and date filters risk high reads and memory grants.
evidence: Delay report spans shipments and event history.
recommendation: Treat as analytical offload candidate; avoid indexing every analytical predicate in OLTP.

expected_plan_risk: Large/critical customers and small customers may need different join/access strategies.
evidence: ServiceTier and customer distribution can skew shipment counts.
recommendation: Investigate Query Store runtime stats, PSP behaviour, Query Store hints, or OPTION(RECOMPILE) for targeted procedure only.
